deterministicPhrases: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Every good wizard deserves a crystal ball and a comfortable chair.
She sells seashells by the seashore. The shells she sells are surely seashells.
How much wood would a woodchuck chuck, if a woodchuck could chuck wood?
Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers. A peck of pickled peppers Peter Piper picked.
To be or not to be, that is the question. Whether 'tis nobler in the mind to suffer the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune.
It was the best of times, it was the worst of times, it was the age of wisdom, it was the age of foolishness.
Space, the final frontier. These are the voyages of the starship Enterprise. Its continuing mission: to explore strange new worlds.

Albert.bio: Classic robotic Mac voice from the original MacinTalk era. Nasal and monotone.

Aman.bio: Indian English male. Modern Siri-class voice, natural intonation.

Bad News.bio: Dramatic downer. Speaks as if delivering terrible news at a funeral.

Bahh.bio: Sounds like a sheep trying to speak English. Bleating vibrato.

Bells.bio: Speaks in bell tones. Each syllable is a chime.

Boing.bio: Spring-loaded bouncing voice. Every word has a cartoon boing.

Bubbles.bio: Underwater gurgling voice. Words bubble up like a scuba diver.

Cellos.bio: Words are sung with cello-like string instrument tones.

Daniel.bio: British English male. Clear, professional, natural-sounding.

Eddy.bio: Friendly, slightly nerdy male voice. Available in many languages.

Flo.bio: Warm, approachable female voice. Slightly raspy, conversational.

Fred.bio: The original Mac voice. Flat, robotic, iconic.

Good News.bio: Upbeat counterpart to Bad News. Enthusiastic musical delivery.

Grandma.bio: Elderly female voice. Warm, wobbly, grandmotherly.

Grandpa.bio: Elderly male voice. Gruff, gravelly, distinguished.

Jester.bio: Playful, mischievous voice. Like a court jester telling riddles.

Junior.bio: Young child's voice. High-pitched, innocent sounding.

Karen.bio: Australian English female. Clear, professional, natural.

Kathy.bio: Classic female Mac voice. Slightly robotic but warmer than Albert.

Moira.bio: Irish English female. Soft, lilting, with a warm Irish cadence.

Organ.bio: Words played as pipe organ chords. Deep, resonant, churchy.

Ralph.bio: Slightly gruff American male. More character than Samantha or Fred.

Reed.bio: Youthful, energetic male voice. Clear and modern.

Rishi.bio: Indian English male. Professional, clear articulation.

Rocko.bio: Rough, tough-guy voice. Like a Brooklyn bouncer.

Samantha.bio: The default macOS voice. Clean, neutral American female.

Sandy.bio: Gentle, soft-spoken female voice. Calm and reassuring.

Shelley.bio: Confident female voice. Slightly assertive, clear delivery.

Superstar.bio: Over-the-top dramatic delivery. Like a rock star announcer.

Tara.bio: Indian English female. Warm, professional, natural-sounding.

Tessa.bio: South African English female. Distinct accent, professional.

Trinoids.bio: Alien robotic voice. Three overlapping tones. Sci-fi vibes.

Whisper.bio: Breathy, quiet whispering voice. ASMR before ASMR existed.

Wobble.bio: Wobbly, vibrating voice. Like speaking through a fan.

Zarvox.bio: Classic alien/robot voice. Monotone with metallic resonance.

Amelie.bio: Canadian French female. Warm Quebecois accent.

Kyoko.bio: Japanese female. Polite, clear standard Japanese.

Lana.bio: Croatian female. Warm Southern European tone.

Luciana.bio: Brazilian Portuguese female. Expressive, warm delivery.

Paulina.bio: Mexican Spanish female. Warm Latin American delivery.

Xander.bio: Dutch male. Clear, friendly Netherlands accent.

Yuna.bio: Korean female. Polite, natural Korean delivery.

Zosia.bio: Polish female. Crisp Eastern European delivery.
